fields.label: Advertised Routes
fields.help: List of IP Prefixes that will be advertised to the remote provider.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Mtu Limit
fields.help: [Output only] The maximum transmission unit (MTU) of a packet that can be sent over this transport.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource, see google.aip.dev/122 for resource naming.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: Resource URL of the Network that will be peered with this Transport.

fields.label: Provided Activation Key
fields.help: Key used for establishing a connection with the remote transport.

fields.label: Remote Account ID
fields.help: The user supplied account id for the CSP associated with the remote profile.

fields.label: Remote Profile
fields.help: Resource URL of the remoteTransportProfile that this Transport is connecting to.

fields.label: Stack Type
fields.help: IP version stack for the established connectivity.
